title: 第5章 逆天改命铸就世间最强体质第6章 太清道体找天帝兽借血
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
来给他们圣主送徒。
这话说的真轻松！
一众圣地长老皱眉。
陈长生知不知道自己在说些什么？
想要当圣主的弟子。
哪有那么简单！
很多古老世族的族长，想让他们的儿子和女儿拜圣主为师，也没能成功。
哪怕他们的儿子和女儿，资质全都非常高，异常出众。
甚至，他们还带过来了诸多无上珍宝。
圣主也没有收徒。
原因是圣主收徒标准非常高。
非绝世逆天妖孽不收！
“小辈，你口气太大了，张口就说来给圣主送徒，你以为你是谁？你送过来的人又是谁？”
白发长老斥喝道：“速速离去，莫要在这里捣乱，这里不是你能随便捣乱的地方！”
“我没有捣乱。”
陈长生依旧平静，道：“还有，我也不是小辈，莫再以小辈称呼我。”
无论是岁数。
还是修为境界。
眼前的白发长老都没资格称呼他为小辈。
不是小辈？

一众圣地长老盯着陈长生。
看了又看。
他们并未从陈长生身上感应到什么恐怖实力。
“不是小辈是什么？”
白发长老皱眉，再次喝道：“速速离去，不要敬酒不吃吃罚酒，自讨苦吃！”
陈长生没动。
也没有说话。
他向前迈了一步。
霎那间。
天地变色！
无穷力量向一众圣地长老压去。
砰砰砰——
没有任何悬念。
一众圣地长老毫无丝毫反抗之力。
全被瞬间压倒在地上！
“什么！
？”
“这…怎么可能！”
content_en:
Come and send disciples to their Holy Lord.
This is so easy to say!
The elders of the Holy Land frowned.
Does Chen Changsheng know what he is talking about?
I want to be a disciple of the Holy Lord.
It's not that simple!
Many patriarchs of ancient clans wanted their sons and daughters to worship the Holy Lord as their teachers, but they failed.
Even their sons and daughters have very high qualifications and are exceptionally outstanding.
They even brought many supreme treasures.
The Holy Master also did not accept any disciples.
The reason is that the Holy Lord’s standards for accepting disciples are very high.
No evildoer will be accepted unless he is a peerless monster!
"Junior, you are too loud. You just said that you are sending disciples to the Holy Lord. Who do you think you are? Who is the person you are sending here?"
The white-haired elder scolded: "Leave quickly, don't make trouble here, this is not a place where you can make trouble casually!"
"I didn't cause any trouble."
Chen Changsheng remained calm and said: "Also, I am not a junior. Please don't call me a junior again."
Regardless of age.
Or the realm of cultivation.
The white-haired elder in front of him is not qualified to call him junior.
Not a junior?
A group of Holy Land elders stared at Chen Changsheng.
Looked and looked.
They did not sense any terrifying strength from Chen Changsheng.
"What is it if it's not a junior?"
The white-haired elder frowned and shouted again: "Leave quickly, don't toast or eat as a penalty, you are asking for trouble!"
Chen Changsheng did not move.
Didn't speak either.
He took a step forward.
All of a sudden.
The world changes color!
Infinite power pressed against the elders of the Holy Land.
Bang bang bang——
There is no suspense.
The elders of the Holy Land showed no resistance at all.
They were all crushed to the ground in an instant!
"What!
? "
"This...how is it possible!"
